verdict.rationale: Cerebras documents OpenAI API compatibility: existing applications switch by changing only the API key, base URL, and model ID. It also supports OpenAI-standard streaming, tool calling, structured outputs, and the image_url content shape, so an agent can likely target it through the standard chat-completions interface. The docs do not show mid-workflow provider switching or the full set of compatibility limits, and one community report of a 422 wrong_api_format error through claude-code-router suggests integrations are not always seamless. missing for 10: explicit documentation of mid-workflow provider switching without per-provider handling, a complete list of OpenAI-compatibility gaps or unsupported parameters, independent hands-on confirmation of drop-in switching in agent frameworks.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can have an agent switch to or away from this provider mid-workflow because it speaks the standard chat-completions API without provider-specific code changes

citations.quote: Existing applications can use Cerebras by changing the API key, base URL, and model ID.
OpenAI API compatibility lets developers build on Cerebras with just two code changes.
The standard OpenAI `image_url` content shape is supported.
